Pilgrims Visit Amarnath Shrine Amid Security Presence

Thousands of pilgrims visited the Amarnath shrine in Kashmir over five days, with security forces providing assistance to those traveling. The event is part of a larger pilgrimage season in India's Jammu and Kashmir region.
